name.quote: The name Wando Formation is proposed for a system of uppermost Pleistocene coastal deposits

rank.quote: The Wando is considered a formation because it is a mappable sequence of deposits

age.quote: THE WANDO FORMATION (UPPER PLEISTOCENE) IN THE

description.value: system of uppermost Pleistocene coastal deposits; main outcrop belt typically 12 km wide and more than 120 km long
description.quote: The main outcrop belt is typically 12 km wide and more than 120 km long.

lithology.value: river-laid coarse sand and gravel and sparse peat; slightly muddy sand to sandy mud; gravel, sand, and plant-bearing clay; well-sorted sand; alternating sand and clay
lithology.quote: These sediments and associated environments include river-laid coarse sand and gravel and sparse peat; slightly muddy sand to sandy mud in backbarrier positions

thickness.value: from a veneer of less than I m to almost 25 m
thickness.quote: The thickness of the Wando Formation ranges from a veneer of less than I m to almost 25 m where barrier deposits overlie channel deposits.
thickness.note: 'I m' is the text layer's rendering of 1 m

contacts.value: unconformably overlies the Cooper Formation or the middle Eocene Santee Limestone; lower contact irregular
contacts.quote: The Wando Formation unconformably overlies the Cooper Formation, a moderately indurated calcareous mud or sand of late Eocene to late Oligocene age or the middle Eocene Santee Limestone

depositional_environment.quote: represent several depositional environments that may be grouped into barrier, backbarrier, and fluvial facies (fig. 6).

fossils.value: shells of brackish to shallow-marine invertebrates
fossils.quote: The shells are of brackish to shallow-marine invertebrates, most of which still live today along the central South Carolina coast

name.quote: Corals from five localities in the Wando Formation have been dated

age.value: 83,000 to 120,000 years before present (uranium disequilibrium series ages of corals); latest Pleistocene
age.quote: The calculated ages of the corals, 83,000 to 120,000 years before present, support a latest Pleistocene age for

description.value: Sand mainly fine- to medium-grained in the marine facies; heavy minerals as much as 26 percent of a beach placer but typically 3-5 percent
description.quote: Heavy minerals constitute as much as 26 percent of a beach placer (Force and others, 1978) but typically constitute 3-5 percent.

lithology.quote: Wando sand is primarily quartz; few samples contain more than 10 percent heavy minerals and feldspar.

contacts.value: basal conglomerate a few centimeters thick with phosphatic pebbles, limy pebbles of the Cooper Formation, and sparse quartz pebbles
contacts.quote: The basal conglomerate of the Wando Formation is a few centimeters thick and includes phosphatic pebbles, limy pebbles of the Cooper Formation, and sparse quartz pebbles.

fossils.quote: The presence of the bivalve Anadara brasiliana is also a good indication of latest Pleistocene age
